Copy for PF.66074 OLDAG

SECRET

Ref: 221,975.F.3.m.

25th August, 1944.

Dear Bulkley,

No. 1451610 L.A.C. LOCKIE, J.A., R.A.F.,
Waterbeach, Cambs.

This is the case on which I rang you up yesterday asking you to obtain as soon as possible the usual particulars and home address of this man, and also his billet address.

Information has been received from a secret source, which it is important to safeguard, showing that LOCKIE is in touch with the Freedom Press anarchists, and evidently shares their views. There is good reason for believing that he is obtaining their literature, and I consider that he should be placed under observation in his unit with a view to learning whether he is spreading subversive propaganda.

For your own information, the reason for the urgency in the case is that LOCKIE has at his home address, and is having sent to his billet, an original drawing entitled "Defend our Heritage" by the anarchist, John OLDAY. I regard OLDAY's propaganda (you will remember that he is the author of "The March to Death") as among the most mischievous of all that is put out by the Freedom Press anarchists.
